The Infrastructural Challenge

The clinic's MRI and ultrasound machines were suffering from micro-cuts and harmonic distortion from the local AEDC transformer, resulting in corrupted scans and equipment degradation. A conventional diesel backup was too slow and too loud for the recovery ward.

Engineered Solution

Installed a dual-redundant 50kVA system acting as a continuous online UPS. The solar array prioritizes charging the critical-load battery bank, ensuring medical equipment is perfectly isolated from grid harmonics and runs on pure synthesized sine-wave power 24/7.
